description: One operational expense, captured from the receipt itself. A foreman photographs the slip in the field, on-device OCR reads the merchant, the total and the date off it, and this is where that lands — with the photo, the raw OCR text and the scanner's own confidence kept beside the extracted fields so a bookkeeper can always check the machine's reading against the paper. Status moves Draft to Submitted to Approved or Rejected; approval and rejection each record who acted and when, and a rejection records why.

fields.description: The Supplier this receipt is from, where the merchant is one this operation has a record for. OPTIONAL and separate from `merchant`, which stays exactly as the paper reads it: a slip printed 'VALLEY CO-OP #14' and a Supplier called 'Valley Co-operative' are the same vendor, and overwriting one with the other loses the evidence. Linking is what lets a year of fuel be totalled per vendor and what a 1099 pre-fill reads.
